summary: New asymmetric haziness in the left mid-to-lower lung zone on current compared with a clearer prior.

findings.rationale: Prior shows relatively symmetric, clear lungs. Current shows the left lung is notably hazier and less well-defined in its mid-to-lower zone compared to the right, with indistinct vascular markings, while the right lung remains comparatively clear. Rotation and portable technique differences are a caveat.
